name: Conzent CMP
description: GDPR/CCPA/ePrivacy cookie-consent banner (IAB TCF v2.2) that injects the Conzent CMP script, with optional Google Tag Manager integration.
project_description:
GDPR, CCPA & ePrivacy compliant cookie consent banner for Drupal. IAB TCF v2.2 and Google CMP Certified.

 Features:

- Injects the Conzent consent banner script into the page head once a website key is verified

- Optional Google Tag Manager container injection with a configurable data-layer name

- Supports both Conzent Cloud and self-hosted (OCI) server URLs

- Single admin settings form; no content entities, plugins, or public endpoints

 Configure at Administration > Configuration > System > Conzent CMP.

 Requires Drupal 10 or 11, PHP 8.1+.
